summary: Phases 1-6 of nine are complete, committed one-per-phase and fully verified: the sliced certificate class now carries a second interesting witness (PlusSlicedCertificate.TotalEdge.certA_certifies -- width 2, total edge, snce/box-dot closure at Pp -> box-dot Pp, kernel decide under a finite heartbeat cap) with its C36 inventory row and matched C2 axiom pin, and the early-exit iteration plus the hoisted inner fixpoint are landed behind eight unconditional equality lemmas. Measured this round: the embedded witness's liveAt (-1) fell from 20225 ms to 2188 ms, and the research report's diagnosis reproduced within 1.12x. Phase 7 is BLOCKED, not excluded: its gate PASSED (5.5x on decide, 63x on eval), the cache landed and built scoped-green, and the full build then broke five rfl-proved withBx_* transfer lemmas in Complete.lean -- a file the phase's own Scope Hypothesis asserted untouched. A scratch test at ten times the heartbeat cap shows rfl fails outright rather than slowly, so no cap bump can fix it; the plan's literal Shape A is equally untransferable and separately 6.2x slower than no cache. Phases 8-9 are NOT STARTED behind Phase 7. The tree is green: full guarded lake build 2844 jobs, check-module-invariants.sh ALL CHECKS PASSED, zero sorries, axiom count unchanged at 12.
blockers: Phase 7 needs a planning decision, recorded via /revise, before any further edit to Timed.lean. Route (i): re-express verts as G.winTimes.biUnion (fun t => (G.posAt t).image (fun p => (p, t))) -- proved rfl-transferable in a scratch test, obtains the same 512-to-4 reduction in posAt calls, leaves Complete.lean untouched, but drops posTable / posAtC / posAtC_eq from the plan's Goals and Lean Challenge Statements, which is a decomposition change. Route (ii): keep the measured 5.5x cache and add roughly fourteen propositional withBx_* transfer lemmas to Complete.lean, which is a scope change the phase never declared. plan-compliance.md requires both to be raised rather than substituted. The attempt is preserved at specs/716_sliced_certificate_liveat_nontermination/probes/20_phase7_shapeB_attempt.diff and in git stash@{0}.
